items.project: The Hoxton Homes Abu Dhabi Saadiyat
items.title: Aldar and Ennismore launch first Hoxton-branded residences in NOMA
items.summary: Almost 100 one- and two-bedroom apartments of roughly 64 to 145 sqm, with a private lobby, clubhouse and gym, sit alongside The Hoxton Abu Dhabi Saadiyat hotel. No opening or handover date has been announced.
